answer: Personalized PageRank resists sybils: trust rank is a random walk that constantly teleports back to the honest seed set, so weight concentrates near the anchor of known-good identities and decays with graph distance. A sybil cluster can spiral edges among itself all it likes, but with no real inbound path from the seeds the teleport keeps resetting away from it — their self-mirror collects negligible rank. Influence tracks proximity to the trusted anchor, which fakes cannot manufacture from outside.
